trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned; there is no extra task beyond finishing the list. Plan the run around the long poles: the story (roughly 60-80 hours), the 100% completion checklist and the collectible sweeps, about 200 hours in total on PowerPyx's roadmap. Keep cheats off for the entire run, because using one disables trophies and saving. When your last remaining trophy pops, this one follows immediately.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission that introduces the two leads and the Leonida coastline. It cannot be skipped: play through the prologue, follow the on-screen prompts while you learn movement, driving and the basics, and the trophy pops as the mission wraps up. On a fresh file this is the first trophy you will earn.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The chapter teaches the core loop — driving, shooting, the wanted system and switching between the two leads — and this trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene. Before you move on, take the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude): the published guides flag it as the list's one missable moment, and there is no mission replay to go back for it later.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2, which leans into the leads' money troubles and their first serious scores. The chapter itself must be finished to progress, so the trophy cannot be skipped; but remember there is no mission replay, so any one-off feat tied to a Chapter 2 mission has to be done while you are there. Make a manual save at the chapter break, as KeenGamer's roadmap advises, so you always keep a way back.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. By now the map is opening up, so this is the chapter to start your long-term habits: scan new vehicles for Whip It Good, tag WAiNK locations as you pass them, and try each new activity type once toward Master of None. The trophy itself pops automatically at the end of the chapter's final mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the penultimate chapter. Keep a manual save at the chapter boundary before you start the endgame stretch. Free-roam continues after the credits, so nothing on the checklist is locked away by finishing, but it is tidier to arrive at the finale with your side content current. The trophy pops at the chapter's closing cutscene.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission, the last step of the story. Winning this gold also unlocks the post-story state that makes the platinum practical: free-roam continues, the 100% Completion checklist becomes viewable (Touch Pad > Progress > Stats), and every remaining trophy can be cleaned up at leisure. There is no mission replay, so if a mission-specific feat is still on your list, do it before you start the finale.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story beat, so it unlocks simply by playing the campaign in order: follow the mission marker when it appears during the early chapters and finish the job. No optional objective, medal or side condition is tracked for this one.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a named story mission. Campaign heists are scripted set-pieces, so just play it through when it becomes available and the trophy pops on completion. The free-roam robbery trophies (Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play) are separate feats and can be done at any time.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission bronzes, it is earned by progressing the campaign: no optional objective or medal is required. If you are following the roadmap, it arrives during your Stage 1 story playthrough.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Play the mission when it appears in the campaign and finish it; the trophy is awarded automatically at the mission's end. No missable condition is attached to it beyond finishing the mission itself.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. The mission also teaches you the airport's layout: the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy (an unscheduled departure at VCIA) is easiest to attempt once you know your way around the airfield. Finish the mission to earn this bronze.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. A straight campaign completion trophy: play the mission through when it appears and it pops at the end. Keep your manual saves at the chapter boundaries and you will never need to worry about it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist only becomes viewable after the story (Touch Pad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress made during the story already counts toward it. It is the game's longest grind: PowerPyx notes the checklist asks for roughly 60% of everything the game offers — story, robberies, gang operations, bank vaults, ranges, races, part of the collectibles, and 70 of the 80 challenges. Work it methodically after the credits and expect this gold to be one of the last trophies you earn.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's stunt jumps and similar set-piece leaps scattered across Leonida; Push Square counts 397 in total, so you need a little over half of them. Found stunts appear on the map (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots) and your tally lives under Progress > Activities > Stunts. Clear them region by region during the Stage 2 and 3 sweeps rather than in one sitting.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's 9 activity types once — races, shooting ranges, drone races, fishing, arcade games, meditation and the rest of Leonida's pastimes. You do not need to win or score well; a single attempt at each type registers it. Most types are introduced during the story, so check your Progress screen late in Stage 1 and deliberately sample whatever is still greyed out.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges open up as you explore; each challenge grades your score, and gold asks for accuracy and speed together, so learn a challenge at a lower medal first, then push for gold with the weapon you handle best. Track which ranges still owe you a gold under Progress > Activities and mop them up in Stage 3 — they also count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. A finish is not enough — you must come first — so learn each course's line with a practice run, then race it clean; drone handling rewards smooth cornering over full-throttle straights. The locations are spread across the whole map, so fold them into your exploration sweep and tick them off region by region.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeat wins on the same track do not add to the count — the word 'different' is the requirement — so move around the map's race series (street, off-road, water and air) and take one win in each. Any vehicle class counts as long as you cross the line first; if a race keeps beating you, come back with a faster, upgraded ride.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of Leonida's activity types: find Cal at his fishing spot, accept his challenge and land the better catch under the rules he sets. If he keeps out-fishing you, work through the fishing progression first to improve your tackle — the challenge can be retried, so treat the first attempts as practice.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Leonida: walk up, play, and finish a full game — win or lose, completion is what counts. This is usually earned in passing while sampling activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's character strand. Andy's missions appear as optional markers during and after the story; work through the strand in order and the trophy pops when his last job is done. Character strands like this one also feed the Strangers & Freaks count, so prioritise them in Stage 3.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's strand. Follow Kenton's optional mission markers whenever they appear and finish the chain; the trophy is awarded at the end of his final mission. Strands stay available in free-roam after the story, so this can be cleaned up in Stage 3 if you skipped it earlier.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand. Billy's jobs are optional character missions: accept each one as it is offered, finish the chain, and the trophy pops at the end of his last mission. Doing the character strands as they appear keeps Stage 3 short.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand is a chain: starting a stranger's missions is not enough — you must see 8 different strands through to their final missions (the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone chains all count). Stranger markers appear as you explore; GTABase's roadmap treats this as its own clean-up step after the 100% push, so track the strands you have started and finish what you begin.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand. Randy's jobs revolve around moving product: accept each mission as it appears, finish the chain, and the trophy pops at the end of his final job. Like the other character strands, it remains available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. Work through Tyrone's optional missions in order; the trophy is awarded when his last mission ends. Finish all five named character strands and you will also be most of the way to Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and mind the one missable step in the whole list. PowerPyx, KeenGamer and GTABase all flag the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house (the balcony meditation with Lucia) as skippable, and with no mission replay there is no way back for it in that playthrough. Do that meditation the moment it is offered in Chapter 1, keep a manual save at each chapter break, and collect the remaining spots at leisure: the other 17 stay available in free-roam.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's strand is the hunting line: take his missions, study animals through the binoculars to learn their habits (studying wildlife also feeds the 100% checklist), and track the one unique specimen he names. When the hunt is offered, follow it through in the same session so the trail does not go cold.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — in shops, bars, landmarks and out-of-the-way corners — and a set completes when every card in it has been collected. KeenGamer's completion notes count 15 completable sets in the game, so you need only a fifth of them for this trophy: focus on the three sets whose cards cluster in regions you sweep early, and use the collection screen to see which sets are nearly done.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-world app used to tag and scan the world — vehicles, animals and marked locations — and using it at 100 distinct locations builds this count. Make it a habit from the first hour: tag something in every new district you enter and the trophy lands naturally during exploration. PowerPyx's roadmap also recommends scanning as you go, because vehicle scans feed Whip It Good and the 100% checklist as well.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's skill tests — the full set numbers 80, of which the 100% checklist wants 70 — so this trophy's bar of 50 is the friendlier one. Pick challenges that suit your play style across driving, shooting, stunt and exploration tests, and skip the hardest few. Your count is tracked under Progress, so check it during Stage 3 and target the categories where you are already closest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat. Raise hell together until the wanted level hits four stars, then break line of sight and hide — swap vehicles, go off-road or duck into cover — until the search ends. Both conditions matter: your partner must be present and the escape must complete, so do not split up mid-chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level at any point. Plan a route of three shops close together, rob the first, and move straight to the next while the heat is still on — if the wanted level fully clears between shops, the chain resets. A fast car waiting outside each shop and your partner covering the door make this far easier.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in it or scan it with the WAiNK app, and Leonida's roads are full of variety, so vary your driving: scan new models whenever one catches your eye instead of living in a single favourite car. PowerPyx notes that 200 of the game's 277 base models are scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy is only the halfway point of that habit.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.label: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the leads' slow-motion aiming ability. Charge the meter, then trigger it in a crowded firefight — a gang operation or a busy story shootout — and drop five targets before the effect ends; headshots conserve the meter. If a fight is too sparse, let enemies group up before activating it. Failed attempts cost nothing, so retry on the next big fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, take off from Vice City International Airport in a plane you were never cleared to fly. Grab an aircraft on the airfield (expect a wanted level for it), get it airborne, and the trophy pops as you leave the airport behind. The story mission VCIA Takedown teaches you the layout; attempting this in free-roam afterwards keeps it repeatable whenever you need another try.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino, the game's tank. This is one of the list's deliberately cryptic hidden trophies: get into a Rhino when heavy military heat brings armour out (a maximum wanted level draws the strongest response) and spend time operating it under fire. The published lists agree on the wording but the precise trigger is a community-confirmed detail, so if simply driving one does not pop it, stay in the tank through a full wanted-level escape and try again.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Scope the store first, go in quietly — no weapon drawn on the door, no alarms tripped — take the goods and walk out before anyone raises the alert; being spotted mid-robbery voids the attempt. If one store's layout keeps exposing you, pick a quieter one and try at night. The trophy only needs one clean job.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault jobs are the heavy end of the robbery ladder: case the bank, bring your partner and a fast getaway car, crack the vault, and lose the heat afterwards — a robbery you are caught during does not count. KeenGamer's completion notes count 8 vault robberies among the 100% requirements, so five clean escapes also move A Long Road forward.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida: stop one by blocking or disabling it, crack the rear doors, take the cash and break away before the response pins you down. The escape is part of the requirement — the trophy pops once you have lost the heat with the money in hand.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every one of its 52 areas. An area registers when you first set foot in it, so this is a pure exploration sweep: ride every highway, island and backwater on the map until no region is unvisited. Do it alongside the Stage 2 collectible sweeps — meditations, cards and WAiNK spots will drag you into most corners anyway — then scan the map for any district you somehow never touched.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one operation for each of Leonida's 9 gangs, rather than farming the same gang nine times. Every gang runs operations on its own turf, so work the map gang by gang and keep a note of which ones you have already hit. Gang operations also feed the 100% checklist (KeenGamer counts 39 operations in total), so none of the trips are wasted.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach strip, order a cocktail at a beachfront bar, and drink it where the description asks — with the ocean in front of you. It is a quiet moment with nothing missable attached: if it does not pop at the first bar, try another beachfront spot along the same strip.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get into a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass frontage rather than through the door — the 'classic style' the description winks at. Any showroom with a display car and a glass front works; expect a wanted level for the exit.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Find the alley, start a game of bowling there and play it through to the end — the trophy's wording riffs on the series' old bowling pastime, and the requirement is simply to bowl at the named alley. It also counts as one of the activity types sampled for Master of None if you have not bowled yet.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — is one of the list's riddles: it points to a shared moment between the two leads performed in front of an audience. Play the partner content in public places — races, robberies and events in crowded spots with both leads together — and it pops from the qualifying moment. The published lists carry the same wording without one confirmed trigger, so treat this as an earn-it-by-playing trophy rather than a checklist step.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: A counter trophy: PlayStation tracks your in-game choices toward a total of 500, so it fills in as you make decisions across the story and free-roam — dialogue picks, mercy-or-mayhem moments and other either/or calls. There is nothing to farm in a single spot; if it is still outstanding late in Stage 3, keep playing content that presents choices and it will complete on its own.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: succeed at something on your second attempt, right after failing it once. The natural way to earn it is organic — fail a race, a challenge or a robbery approach, immediately retry it, and succeed. If you are cleaning up deliberately, pick a short race, lose it on purpose, then win the retry.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This is the list's Easter-egg bronze: Leonida hides odd encounters off the beaten path — strange lights and stranger-than-usual strangers, mostly at night and away from the city. The published lists keep the wording deliberately vague because the trigger is a discovery, so explore rural Leonida after dark during your Stage 2 sweeps and investigate anything that looks out of place.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving slowly past a pedestrian or rival, use your melee attack so the swing knocks them down like a bowling pin — the melee contact is what the trophy asks for, so aim for a clean sideswipe rather than a full-speed run-over. A crowded sidewalk at low speed gives you plenty of attempts.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.label: Push Square — GTA VI Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them to your laundering contacts, who return clean money for a cut. The counter is cumulative earnings through laundering, so route every marked payout through your contacts from mid-game on and the total builds quickly alongside the robbery trophies.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spending anywhere — clothes, weapons, vehicles, services — counts toward the total, so this usually pops on its own during a full playthrough. If you are short late in the run, Leonida's luxury shops will happily take the rest; there is no need to spend it all in one place or one session.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought from property listings as they unlock across the story; you need the cash, and for some of them the story progress, before they are offered. Buy each one as it appears rather than saving for a spree — owning garages also gives you storage for the vehicles behind Whip It Good and On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.label: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, use the app to register it; ten registrations is a small ask once you are already scanning and discovering vehicles for Whip It Good. Register distinct vehicles as you encounter them — the garages from Little Boxes give you somewhere to keep them all.
trophies.name: On the Spot
